features: Fixes Automated Scoring progress after judge submission in both Live and Test engines
Submitted judges now report 100 percent progress even when Blank selections are intentionally left on non-selected competitors
Heats progress now uses the configured YES quota plus available A1/A2/A3 selections rather than treating every competitor as requiring a mark
Final progress now tracks ranked confirmed couples correctly in the Test engine as well as Live scoring
Live Display scoring feed now receives a dynamic data version derived from judge sessions and score updates
The projector scoring screen automatically reloads when judge marks are saved or a judge submits, without requiring a manual projector control change
Live Display continues polling approximately every 700 ms with no-cache requests
Test and Live progress logic remain synchronized while Test retains its generator and simulator tools
